messages:
amy_cs: Quick sync for Nebula cohort — enrollment + feedback loop planning. Need: final seat counts, enablement owners, and a cadence for feedback. Proposing: weekly 30m check-ins (Wed 11am PT) + a biweekly feedback digest. Also flag any renewal risks we should surface to AMs. Can folks ack and call out blockers?

maria_onboard: Ack. I can run 4/10 and 4/17 at 11am PT for the enablement workshops. Will need 3 test API keys and a staging tag 'nebula-pilot' for the customers. I can prepare a 20m walkthrough + 10m Q&A slide deck.

devon_se: Confirmed on tech side. We can mint 3 keys and create an allowlist for customer IPs — but FYI one customer (Stratify) uses a corporate proxy that blocks unknown certs. Might need an allowlist change or a tunnel. I will drop a short test snippet for them.

amy_cs: thanks — Maria plz add the slide link when ready. Devon, can you post the snippet here and the steps for firewall customers? I'll draft the invite after we lock seats.

devon_se: Snippet here: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEBULA_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Steps: 1) add client IPs to allowlist (send to netops@stratify.com), 2) if proxy intercepts TLS -> provide CA to them or use outbound tunnel. I put a short playbook in Confluence: /confluence/nebula/onboard-playbook.md

sven_support: I'll create #nebula-support and a shared mailbox (nebula-support@redwood.ai). Also adding an SLO alert: error-rate >2% over 5m to trigger on-call. We should surface top-2 failure modes in the first digest.

leila_am: Heads-up — Stratify is showing early renewal risk; finance/legal are still finalizing the NDA amendment for pilot data retention. I'll escalate with legal and loop you, @amy_cs. Might impact go/no-go for that tenant.

amy_cs: good catch Leila. Please add any risk notes to the cohort tracker (sheet) and mark Stratify as "needs legal" so enablement doesn't schedule until cleared. For other customers, proceed as planned.

maria_onboard: Slide draft: https://redwood.docs/nebula/enablement-deck (WIP). I also made a short feedback form for post-workshop capture: https://forms.redwood.ai/r/nebula-feedback — would like everyone to agree on 3 must-have questions for quality/regression tracking.

devon_se: I'll add a quick prompt set for regression checks. Suggest Qs: 1) relevance 2) hallucination rate 3) latency/throughput impressions.

amy_cs: Perfect. I'll run a 1-question poll for check-in times and lock invites after Maria confirms seats.

calendar-bot: Scheduled "Nebula cohort kickstart" — Wed Apr 10 11:00 PT; invites sent to amy_cs, maria_onboard, devon_se, leila_am, sven_support.

leila_am: I accepted. Also looping legal: @legal-team can we prioritize Stratify NDA amendment?

sven_support: On it — I'll prepare a short runbook for first-line triage and attach it to the digest.

amy_cs: Great progress. Action items recap: Maria -> confirm seats + final deck link; Devon -> provide keys + firewall notes in Confluence; Leila -> escalate Stratify legal; Sven -> create #nebula-support + runbook. I'll send out the check-in poll after Maria confirms. :thumbsup:
